_prompt_descriptive_v0: The remote helper attaches a core-minted bearer token to data-plane git requests. The replica targets it dials are populated from a response header, a redirect Location, and an on-disk node cache — all of which an attacker or a poisoned cache can point at arbitrary hosts. Currently the helper will dial and credential any host these sources name, even ones outside the cluster the user actually addressed, leaking the token off-cluster. Ensure credentialed requests only ever reach hosts belonging to the addressed cluster, at every point such hosts enter. Keep the fix minimal.
